dogecoin.text: 2/ Whatever you say about @elonmusk, the man's a PR master. All drama works to elevate $doge's meme status. You can argue all day about how the tech or the economics won't work. But end of day, what a currency really needs is adoption. And viral memes by definition has adoption.

1/ Smart, rational, and mature people like yourself dismiss $doge as joke. I did too, until @AK_Bull_Worm gave me a rude awakening, and seeing friend's friend posted buying fish w/ doge from Ohio farm... https://t.co/0YSFP7mt0m

Nuanced thinking goes, “Elon Musk will go on SNL—> everyone will expect price to rise, so they’re buying now—> By the time SNL happens, everyone has already bought and nobody is left to buy—> Price will drop—> Let’s sell Dogecoin before SNL or not bother at all.”

Simplistic thinking says, “If A happens, it will lead to B”. Nuanced thinking says, “If A happens, it will lead to B, but also C, D, E. And C, D, E will make B irrelevant”.
 
Simplistic thinking goes, “Elon Musk will go on SNL—> Price will rise—> Let’s buy Dogecoin”.
